look_here_first: Look along the stem first: tiny narrow, densely overlapping, leathery leaves, with a raised midrib and paired longitudinal grooves on the upper face. Confirm the woody/perennial base and, at fruiting, a single series of roughly 24–26 white barbellate pappus bristles; unlike the tiny pappus rings of C. effusa and C. bellidifolia.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low woody-based or rhizomatous perennial with branched hairy, sometimes glandular stems; usually a small clump.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, densely overlapping, narrow and firm, commonly 2–10 mm long; upper surface with strongly raised midnerve and paired longitudinal grooves (FNA key).

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Small solitary terminal radiate heads with white to pinkish rays, yellow disk florets and often reddish-tipped phyllaries; ray color changes and is not diagnostic.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: Cypselae carry one series of usually 24–26 (occasionally 20–30) white barbellate pappus bristles (FNA key).

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Examine basal and stem leaves including overlap and blade bases

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Examine mature cypsela pappus with magnification
